DeterminationBasis: Existing claim-scope, independent-verification and PL3 procedure/evidence controls do not require a PL5 representation to identify the reproduction conditions and the result. Reproduction conditions are a distinct proof-level basis because they define the circumstances under which the result is reproduced and must remain inspectable with that result. PROOF-007 therefore requires a distinct PL5 reproduction-conditions-and-result test.

T16-013 requires every conformance claim to identify or unambiguously bind the exact standard version and the conformance profile relied upon. Naming or unambiguously binding the claimed profile therefore directly satisfies CONF-001, while T16-013 additionally preserves exact standard-version identity. No additional test definition is required.
